subject.title: fix(feishu): bound Feishu API JSON response reads to prevent OOM

question: Should OpenClaw accept a 16 MiB fail-closed cap for Feishu/Lark app-registration and streaming-card control-plane JSON responses?
rationale: The cap is a security/availability hardening improvement, but green CI cannot prove every legitimate Feishu/Lark deployment response is below the chosen size boundary.

options.title: Accept 16 MiB cap
options.body: Merge this branch or an equivalent single fix with the shared provider helper and treat oversized Feishu/Lark JSON as an error.

options.title: Adjust the cap
options.body: Ask for a different cap or per-call caps before merge if maintainers want a different compatibility boundary for Feishu/Lark APIs.

options.title: Defer bounded reads
options.body: Keep current unbounded behavior only if maintainer policy prefers avoiding any fail-closed response-size behavior for this plugin.

recommendation.title: Accept 16 MiB cap
recommendation.body: Merge this branch or an equivalent single fix with the shared provider helper and treat oversized Feishu/Lark JSON as an error.

likelyOwner.reason: The cap affects streaming-card runtime behavior, and vincentkoc is tied to the canonical merged streaming-card delivery cluster.
